name: Before the Reboot
tagline: Finished, tracker-inspired reinterpretations of Star Splitter compositions.
oneSentenceBio: Before the Reboot rebuilds fully formed songs through tracker-inspired tones, revealing the melody, rhythm, harmony, and counterpoint beneath modern production.
threeSentenceBio: Before the Reboot presents finished reinterpretations of songs through a vivid tracker and chiptune vocabulary. Rather than reducing the music to novelty nostalgia, it brings the underlying composition forward: interlocking melodies, programmed rhythms, countermelodies, and carefully shaped form. Each release feels like a complete alternate reality in which the song grew up inside glowing grids, limited voices, and endlessly inventive electronic constraints.
paragraphBio: Before the Reboot takes complete songs and translates them into a world of trackers, compact waveforms, crisp programmed drums, and tightly interlocking melodic lines. The appeal is not imitation of an old game console, nor a deliberately unfinished demo aesthetic. These are polished, release-ready reinterpretations that use limited electronic voices to reveal how the music is constructed. Melodies become more exposed, rhythmic decisions become more visible, and harmonic movement can be heard without the camouflage of a dense contemporary mix. The results often carry a strange double nostalgia: they feel connected to an earlier digital era, yet also like artifacts from a past that never quite existed. Playfulness matters, but so does craft. Every arrangement must preserve the recognizable identity of the source while discovering new momentum, color, and counterpoint inside it. Before the Reboot is for listeners drawn to chiptune, tracker music, melodic game soundtracks, and the satisfying clarity of hearing a composition reduced to its brightest essential signals.
